SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) — INVESTIGATION NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-010

I. SUMMARY (WHAT):
Between 2016-12-02 18:18:27 and 2016-12-02 18:18:27, suspicious transaction activity totaling $1,000.03 USD was identified across 1 transaction(s) involving card C10434-K1 associated with customer profile C10434. The primary suspicious pattern identified is 'card_not_present_new_device'.

II. SUBJECTS & INSTRUMENTS (WHO):
Primary Customer Identifier: C10434
Primary Card Number Reference: C10434-K1
Connected / Correlated Cards: C11923, C13171, C02354
Associated Device Telemetry: Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768

III. TIMELINE & GEOGRAPHIC PROFILE (WHEN & WHERE):
Earliest Flagged Transaction Date: 2016-12-02 18:18:27
Latest Activity Timestamp: 2016-12-02 18:18:27
Affected Transaction Record IDs: 3506725

IV. METHOD OF OPERATION & EVIDENCE (WHY & HOW):
Transaction in established billing region 469.0 (cardholder has 24 prior transactions here).; Device profile Windows observed across 3 other distinct customer accounts.; Transaction initiated from a newly observed device profile: Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768.; Bank upstream fraud detection model flagged transaction with high risk score of 0.90.; Cardholder denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed card remains in physical possession.
Multi-Entity Syndicate Linkage: Graph analysis revealed that the device profile (Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768) is shared across multiple cardholder profiles, indicating coordinated synthetic identity or card-not-present syndicate activity.

V. INSTITUTIONAL ACTION TAKEN:
The bank initiated immediate card control actions under Bank Fraud Policy v1.0. Customer validation confirmed unauthorized access. The card was permanently blocked and placed on fraud monitoring. This filing is submitted pursuant to BSA/AML compliance mandates.
